archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for B2B CRM

layout_and_spacing.page_container: max-w-5xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-8

components_strategy.coupon_type_selector: A grid layout (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3). Each card is a selectable button. Active state: border-[#F26B33] bg-[#FEF3EE] ring-1 ring-[#F26B33]. Inactive state: border-gray-200 bg-white hover:border-gray-300. V3 'Coming Soon' cards (Time-window, BOGO, Every-Nth) must have opacity-60, cursor-not-allowed, and feature a small Shadcn Badge reading 'Coming Soon'.
components_strategy.dynamic_form_sections: Conditional rendering based on coupon type. For V1: show flat/percentage input fields. For V2: reveal the Item/Category searchable selector built with Shadcn Command/Combobox component.
components_strategy.advanced_settings: Shadcn Accordion component at the bottom of the form to hide 'max_applications', 'allow_repeat', and 'pos_instruction'. Title should clearly state 'Advanced Settings' to keep the default UI uncluttered.
components_strategy.list_page_enhancements: Use Shadcn Badges for visual Type indicators (e.g., Flat, Percentage, Item-level) on the list page. Add Shadcn Switch directly in the row for quick Active/Inactive toggling. Implement a Shadcn Input above the table for searching.
components_strategy.status_toggle: Shadcn Switch component used for active/inactive status. Checked state uses the success color (#10B981) or primary (#F26B33).

testing_attributes.requirement: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build the UI in React (.js), utilizing Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI.
2. Use a hybrid form structure: visual card-based selector at the top dictates the dynamic fields rendered below.
3. 'Coming Soon' features (V3) must be visually present but unclickable, displaying a badge.
4. Adhere strictly to the 'rounded-xl' border radius and '#F26B33' primary color to match the existing CRM theme.
5. The Item/Category selector must simulate a live catalog search using a combobox.
6. Add 'data-testid' to every form input, button, and toggle for end-to-end testing.
7. Include Montserrat font setup in the global CSS or Tailwind config.
